EPON OLT PON SFP Module E14D9PX20+++ — High-Performance EPON Optical Transceiver | D CORE


Upgrade your EPON network with the EPON OLT PON SFP Module E14D9PX20+++, a high-power and long-distance optical transceiver designed for ISP, FTTH, and enterprise fiber deployments. This advanced EPON OLT module delivers reliable 1.25Gbps upstream and downstream performance, ensuring seamless connectivity across your fiber network.


Perfect for Bangladeshi ISPs, FTTH providers, and large-scale network infrastructures, this PX20+++ SFP module provides extended optical power and stable long-range performance up to 20km over single-mode fiber.


Key Features


  • EPON OLT SFP Module (E14D9PX20+++)
    Designed for 1.25Gbps EPON OLT applications with stable, high-power transmission.

  • Long-Distance Coverage — Up to 20km
    Ideal for FTTH / FTTB / FTTx deployments with passive optical splitters.

  • Optical Wavelength:

    • 1490nm (TX Downstream)

    • 1310nm (RX Upstream)

  • High Optical Power (PX20+++)
    Ensures stronger signal output for large splitter ratios and long fiber routes.

  • Single-Mode, Single-Fiber (BIDI) Technology
    Transmits and receives data over one fiber using SC/UPC connector.

  • 1.25Gbps Data Rate
    Compliant with IEEE 802.3ah EPON standards for symmetrical data transmission.

  • Hot-Pluggable SFP Form Factor
    Easy installation and maintenance for all major OLT brands.

  • Digital Diagnostics Monitoring (DDM Supported)
    Real-time optical power, temperature, and voltage monitoring.
